actor.name: 棍木女

rels.bio: 棍木女曾在面馆外主动接触李好，并赠予他一枚木签。

actor.notes:
与辛桦、闻笙及两名队员共一张行动卡；全组每轮合计一次调位、跳帮、援助、救援、考验或攻击。必要驾驶按模组处理。

先观察、固定连接或救坠落者，不把金瞳与喉部义体当武器。李好可凭外貌认出棍木女，本名待她自行介绍；沿用现有Actor显示名。木签检查留到脱离火线后，原物归还。

只比较实际接触的余响；没有自动副本，不替PC选择交管7号的保存方案。

rels.customRole: 照片托付者／事务所老板
rels.bio: 沈漫在高铁上把阿瑶的照片交给李好；两人后来一起生活在事务所。影子银行遇袭后，沈漫把重伤的李好救回云路镇的安全屋，取出了弹头。
李好与何凌曾在江城分行共事。影子银行遇袭后，何凌说明自己是接替陈培安的审查员，与李好结盟，要一起扳倒方泰安和行长。何凌愿意见李好的同伴。
李好已替白念秋的姐姐传达了托付的请求。白念秋已经离世。
李好在码头事件中救出萨布里娜；她后来当面向他道谢。
码头事件后，阿瑶修补了众人的身体；大家后来在事务所确认了彼此的生命绑定。
陈志远是李好在龙散分行的直接上级。
沈漫的堂弟，管事务所的电竞房和发电机，也帮忙照看阿瑶。
高架上的对手，自称阿奎拉家族执行人“战车”。后来在港口主动归还手机并提出司机合作，李好没有接受。
在铁山北亮出了预制的犯罪案情，警告 5 月 20 日前要找到审核人撤案。闻笙说看到过李好的未来，但不能透露。
高架上受闻笙之命前来支援，帮李好换车、开车，并指导取出黑匣子。
港口山上的少年。李好替他取回被抢的手机，他提供了学校地下防空通道的线索，尚未验证。
第一人民医院的主治医生，沈漫的老同学，负责萨布里娜的义肢方案。
高架混战时跳帮争夺，和马铁鹰互殴。
何凌指认的主要责任人。她说方泰安用义胜盟作黑手套并清理旧帮手，身边有使紫色闪电的高阶觉醒者；手头材料还不足以证明，她周末要想办法与他摊牌。
李好查到的失踪银行员工，3 月初调来龙散，4 月 13 日失踪，与何凌同部门。何凌说他是她的大学前辈，她是来接替他的审查员。
总行派下的常务副行长，兼专项督导组组长，办公室在 28 楼。李好在 OA 上查到履历，也借过他的名号过关，本人没见过。
陈志远提到陶行长刚问过资料。李好没见过本人。
黄区老王头面馆的老板。面馆电脑起火后下落不明，沈漫猜测他成了迷失者。
唐索熟识的黑市商人，在白桦树集装箱迷宫做生意。队伍经他花 ¥12,000 买到旧城管委会地下地图，没见到本人。
死在 2 号线月台，身中三枪，旁边是碎玻璃瓶和白花。遗物是一张白卡纸，背面写着“对不起，我不能再来了，你还在跟他一起走”。生前每周末拿白花去地铁站。
节目里叫苏师傅，像个电工，后来没再露面。队伍在地下尸体堆旁找到他的工牌和三人合照，黑莓里有留给妻女的备忘录。之后在 6 号车厢遇到长得像他的数据幽灵，被凯芙拉的广播击散。
在地铁站开枪的人，队伍做笔录时听到名字，查过他的网络言行。警方口径是精神病患者无差别袭击。
左眼窝是空的，右眼是改装过的旧款机械义眼。凭拍摄许可放行时警告：进 6 号线那段别碰任何还亮的东西。
运行 rh06.1x1 后从老王头面馆的屏幕里钻出来，戴高礼帽，召唤骷髅枪手和数据僵尸，主要针对雷武龙，对 PC 的数据因子有兴趣。设备一响就变了脸色撤退。
码头数据流空间里的黑甲覆面骑士，带着乌鸦群，把全队打倒。阿瑶现身时它露出忌惮。
3—6 号车厢的怪物，吐人、吐寒冰，重护甲，只抓人不杀人。队伍最后把它从车上扔了下去。
覆盖了苏志国遗书的文件里自我介绍，说自己把人的数据化克隆带去彼岸，还谈到数据构成的平行世界。沈漫说不清楚。
沈漫说，rh06.1x1 这个兔子洞程序的作者称号叫红皇后。
沈漫的旧照片上长得像大版阿瑶，2022 年 1 月 14 日最后合照后人间蒸发。她的遗物里发现了 astro gate 程序。
何凌说自己遭枪击后被代号 S.H. 的人救起。
和另一人一起坠楼身亡。5 月 5 日深夜接单，把白念秋从北岭送到旧城管委会。警方没有给结论。
从闪电撕开的裂隙驶上立交的 SUV，驾驶座上有人影，击落了无人机。面貌不明。

[{"id":"ty-bai-death","title":"白念秋之死","imagePath":"worlds/taiyi/assets/npc/avatars/LS-NPC-037.webp","folderId":"ty-folder-0","imageScale":1,"imagePositionX":50,"imagePositionY":50,"revealLevels":[{"level":1,"text":"出隧道后得知，白念秋被发现死于公寓。官方口径是丧姐后抑郁加重、服药过量，警方排除他杀。"},{"level":2,"text":"队伍怀疑官方结论，当场追查碰壁，记录很干净。"}],"fallbackColor":"#7d8fa3","fallbackIcon":"fa-skull","audioPath":""},{"id":"ty-bai-sms","title":"节目已经做好","imagePath":"worlds/taiyi/assets/npc/avatars/LS-NPC-037.webp","folderId":"ty-folder-0","imageScale":1,"imagePositionX":50,"imagePositionY":50,"revealLevels":[{"level":1,"text":"23:25 白念秋给李好发来短信，说新节目做好了，明天播出。"},{"level":2,"text":"新闻画面一角有与地铁6号车厢相同的数据虫洞，只有李好看出。"}],"fallbackColor":"#7d8fa3","fallbackIcon":"fa-message","audioPath":""},{"id":"ty-bai-route","title":"白念秋最后一单","imagePath":"","folderId":"ty-folder-0","imageScale":1,"imagePositionX":50,"imagePositionY":50,"revealLevels":[{"level":1,"text":"交出密钥后查出，老周5月5日深夜接单，把白念秋从北岭送到旧城管委会。"},{"level":2,"text":"老周后来坠楼死亡。队伍表示下一场要查这条路线。"}],"fallbackColor":"#7d8fa3","fallbackIcon":"fa-route","audioPath":""},{"id":"ty-deadline-0520","title":"5月20日案情期限","imagePath":"","folderId":"ty-folder-0","imageScale":1,"imagePositionX":50,"imagePositionY":50,"revealLevels":[{"level":1,"text":"闻笙向欲子展示5月9至10日编辑完的预制犯罪案情，说半小时后上红通。"},{"level":2,"text":"闻笙说5月20日前必须找到审核人撤案。"}],"fallbackColor":"#7d8fa3","fallbackIcon":"fa-calendar-xmark","audioPath":""},{"id":"ty-wensheng","title":"闻笙的说法","imagePath":"","folderId":"ty-folder-0","imageScale":1,"imagePositionX":50,"imagePositionY":50,"revealLevels":[{"level":1,"text":"闻笙说何凌的前辈成为迷失者，建议去找义胜盟，并称看到了李好的未来。"},{"level":2,"text":"闻笙说白念秋之死、老王头失踪都与更大的手有关，但自己也可能借刀。"}],"fallbackColor":"#7d8fa3","fallbackIcon":"fa-eye","audioPath":""},{"id":"ty-bei-ling-list","title":"北岭名单异常","imagePath":"","folderId":"ty-folder-0","imageScale":1,"imagePositionX":50,"imagePositionY":50,"revealLevels":[{"level":1,"text":"唐索下载十二个小区中的十份资料，搜索白念秋无匹配。"},{"level":2,"text":"她记得有一份在没有新住户时于上周被修改，没记清是哪个小区。"}],"fallbackColor":"#7d8fa3","fallbackIcon":"fa-folder-open","audioPath":""},{"id":"ty-stick","title":"棍木女的木签","imagePath":"worlds/taiyi/assets/npc/avatars/LS-NPC-N3.webp","folderId":"ty-folder-0","imageScale":1,"imagePositionX":50,"imagePositionY":50,"revealLevels":[{"level":1,"text":"棍木女在面馆外敲车窗，自称不存在的存在，说李好身上沾染神子的气息。"},{"level":2,"text":"她留下一根木签，说是保护你的东西，随后当场消失。"}],"fallbackColor":"#7d8fa3","fallbackIcon":"fa-wand-sparkles","audioPath":""},{"id":"ty-heling-pact","title":"何凌的同盟","imagePath":"worlds/taiyi/assets/npc/avatars/LS-NPC-046.webp","folderId":"ty-folder-1","imageScale":1,"imagePositionX":50,"imagePositionY":50,"revealLevels":[{"level":1,"text":"何凌赶到安全屋道歉，与李好约定一起扳倒方泰安和行长。"},{"level":2,"text":"她说自己是陈培安的接替审查员，周末要想办法与方泰安摊牌，并愿见李好的同伴。"}],"fallbackColor":"#a3807d","fallbackIcon":"fa-handshake","audioPath":""},{"id":"ty-xuanya","title":"宣亚国际","imagePath":"","folderId":"ty-folder-1","imageScale":1,"imagePositionX":50,"imagePositionY":50,"revealLevels":[{"level":1,"text":"何凌说袭击影子银行的是宣亚国际，受委托封锁大楼、拷走旧城管委会相关数据，行长特批。"},{"level":2,"text":"宣亚曾以200万向行长兜售李好的情报，行长没答应。"}],"fallbackColor":"#a3807d","fallbackIcon":"fa-building-shield","audioPath":""},{"id":"ty-purge-order","title":"行长的清除令","imagePath":"","folderId":"ty-folder-1","imageScale":1,"imagePositionX":50,"imagePositionY":50,"revealLevels":[{"level":1,"text":"何凌说，李好报出裴组长名号让行长警觉，行长密令除掉报该名号的人。"},{"level":2,"text":"她说原本想抓的是她自己，行长至今不知李好是谁。"}],"fallbackColor":"#a3807d","fallbackIcon":"fa-ban","audioPath":""},{"id":"ty-lh-letter","title":"lh的警告信","imagePath":"","folderId":"ty-folder-1","imageScale":1,"imagePositionX":50,"imagePositionY":50,"revealLevels":[{"level":1,"text":"影子银行22楼终端弹出无表头无来源的消息，署名lh。"},{"level":2,"text":"信中说调查已很困难且没有协助者，建议离开。队伍没有确认lh是谁。"}],"fallbackColor":"#a3807d","fallbackIcon":"fa-envelope","audioPath":""},{"id":"ty-chen-pei-an","title":"陈培安","imagePath":"","folderId":"ty-folder-1","imageScale":1,"imagePositionX":50,"imagePositionY":50,"revealLevels":[{"level":1,"text":"李好查到4月13日失踪的银行员工与何凌同部门，何凌是来接替他。"},{"level":2,"text":"何凌口述他是她的大学前辈，正式姓名陈培安。"}],"fallbackColor":"#a3807d","fallbackIcon":"fa-user-slash","audioPath":""},{"id":"ty-lvwenbo-evidence","title":"吕文博的证据","imagePath":"worlds/taiyi/assets/npc/avatars/EP04-S15-lvwenbo-v3.webp","folderId":"ty-folder-2","imageScale":1,"imagePositionX":50,"imagePositionY":50,"revealLevels":[{"level":1,"text":"吕文博战前向欲子兜售当红女星死亡真相，价值20万，可附证据。"},{"level":2,"text":"欲子猜是白念秋，他未确认。他随后被狙杀，证据没有取得。"}],"fallbackColor":"#7da38a","fallbackIcon":"fa-file-circle-question","audioPath":""},{"id":"ty-lvwenbo-assets","title":"吕文博的卡与诊所","imagePath":"worlds/taiyi/assets/npc/avatars/EP04-S15-lvwenbo-v3.webp","folderId":"ty-folder-2","imageScale":1,"imagePositionX":50,"imagePositionY":50,"revealLevels":[{"level":1,"text":"吕文博被冻结的卡里有20万，盟说可运作取出；鹿岛要15万，卫铁生要5万。"},{"level":2,"text":"钢阳街诊所的器械和精神药物归属未定，马铁鹰提议运出去卖抽10%。"}],"fallbackColor":"#7da38a","fallbackIcon":"fa-sack-dollar","audioPath":""},{"id":"ty-luokai","title":"狙击手罗凯","imagePath":"","folderId":"ty-folder-2","imageScale":1,"imagePositionX":50,"imagePositionY":50,"revealLevels":[{"level":1,"text":"隐身狙击手向唐索开一枪，击杀吕文博后化黑雾离开。"},{"level":2,"text":"柳拂衣说他是玄盾国际的罗凯，目的是给吕文博灭口，玄盾内部有三四个实验室培育超人。"}],"fallbackColor":"#7da38a","fallbackIcon":"fa-crosshairs","audioPath":""},{"id":"ty-new-identity","title":"设计院秘书身份","imagePath":"","folderId":"ty-folder-2","imageScale":1,"imagePositionX":50,"imagePositionY":50,"revealLevels":[{"level":1,"text":"盟主给欲子设计院办公室秘书职位：3级身份，每周800元，6点下班。"},{"level":2,"text":"欲子选了楚江西路的小办公室，说养两三个月可到4级，再久到5级。"}],"fallbackColor":"#7da38a","fallbackIcon":"fa-id-card","audioPath":""},{"id":"ty-lushima","title":"鹿岛的招揽","imagePath":"worlds/taiyi/assets/npc/avatars/LS-NPC-063.webp","folderId":"ty-folder-2","imageScale":1,"imagePositionX":50,"imagePositionY":50,"revealLevels":[{"level":1,"text":"鹿岛是霜月会代表，在铜锅为欲子设局，招揽她。"},{"level":2,"text":"欲子拿到联络点：云里路云里互娱，找鹿岛。"}],"fallbackColor":"#7da38a","fallbackIcon":"fa-handshake-angle","audioPath":""},{"id":"ty-wei-deal","title":"卫铁生的联手条件","imagePath":"worlds/taiyi/assets/npc/avatars/LS-NPC-056.webp","folderId":"ty-folder-2","imageScale":1,"imagePositionX":50,"imagePositionY":50,"revealLevels":[{"level":1,"text":"卫铁生口头同意与唐索对付旧城管委会：黑料归PC，追回的脏钱归卫，仓库各拿各的。"},{"level":2,"text":"卫说管委会欠盟二三十万、贪了千万以上；联络点在滨江绿带，报铁生哥。"}],"fallbackColor":"#7da38a","fallbackIcon":"fa-people-arrows","audioPath":""},{"id":"ty-guanwei-map","title":"管委会地下地图","imagePath":"worlds/taiyi/assets/shops/20260903/birch-avatar-v1.webp","folderId":"ty-folder-3","imageScale":1,"imagePositionX":50,"imagePositionY":50,"revealLevels":[{"level":1,"text":"唐索以12000元（3000/6000/3000分摊）买到旧城管委会地下一块的地图，已送达存下。"},{"level":2,"text":"唐索读图后认为可从车库入口进。"}],"fallbackColor":"#9a8fb0","fallbackIcon":"fa-map","audioPath":""},{"id":"ty-fangtaian","title":"方泰安","imagePath":"","folderId":"ty-folder-3","imageScale":1,"imagePositionX":50,"imagePositionY":50,"revealLevels":[{"level":1,"text":"何凌说方泰安是旧城管委会主任，曾用义胜盟作黑手套并清理旧帮手。"},{"level":2,"text":"她说手头材料尚不足以证明，周末要想办法与他摊牌。"}],"fallbackColor":"#9a8fb0","fallbackIcon":"fa-landmark","audioPath":""},{"id":"ty-fang-guard","title":"方泰安的护卫","imagePath":"","folderId":"ty-folder-3","imageScale":1,"imagePositionX":50,"imagePositionY":50,"revealLevels":[{"level":1,"text":"阿尔坎查到方有玄盾个人金卡，约十八人护卫队。"},{"level":2,"text":"私人聊天形容其随从令人窒息，像消失又出现，断电时发光；未能确认能力与身份。"}],"fallbackColor":"#9a8fb0","fallbackIcon":"fa-user-shield","audioPath":""},{"id":"ty-liang-help","title":"梁文川的协助","imagePath":"worlds/taiyi/assets/npc/avatars/LS-NPC-101.webp","folderId":"ty-folder-3","imageScale":1,"imagePositionX":50,"imagePositionY":50,"revealLevels":[{"level":1,"text":"梁文川自称追风前执行总裁、现技术高管，送欲子就医并垫付费用。"},{"level":2,"text":"他愿查违规使用机甲者，确认管委会买过设备，但要求实际证据。"}],"fallbackColor":"#9a8fb0","fallbackIcon":"fa-wrench","audioPath":""},{"id":"ty-shenxiang","title":"神响之地","imagePath":"worlds/taiyi/assets/npc/avatars/LS-NPC-090.webp","folderId":"ty-folder-4","imageScale":1,"imagePositionX":50,"imagePositionY":50,"revealLevels":[{"level":1,"text":"阿瑶梦中方向指向东南，有人在等她；沈漫建议谨慎看待，也让PC力所能及地帮她。"},{"level":2,"text":"沈漫推测神响之地在旧城区地下；唐索问闻笙，他回避并否认听过。"}],"fallbackColor":"#b09a6e","fallbackIcon":"fa-compass","audioPath":""},{"id":"ty-ayao-bond","title":"阿瑶的生命绑定","imagePath":"worlds/taiyi/assets/npc/avatars/LS-NPC-090.webp","folderId":"ty-folder-4","imageScale":1,"imagePositionX":50,"imagePositionY":50,"revealLevels":[{"level":1,"text":"沈漫在事务所解释：PC与阿瑶存在生命绑定，数据因子是能力来源。"},{"level":2,"text":"沈漫猜想补完阿瑶可解除绑定。阿瑶被数据生物称为天灾。"}],"fallbackColor":"#b09a6e","fallbackIcon":"fa-link","audioPath":""},{"id":"ty-ayao-school","title":"阿瑶的学校","imagePath":"worlds/taiyi/assets/npc/avatars/LS-NPC-090.webp","folderId":"ty-folder-4","imageScale":1,"imagePositionX":50,"imagePosit gate程序，破解时自毁并夺走她的右手，已追查8年。"}],"fallbackColor":"#b09a6e","fallbackIcon":"fa-image-portrait","audioPath":""},{"id":"ty-shenman-list","title":"沈漫与玄盾私榜","imagePath":"worlds/taiyi/assets/npc/avatars/LS-NPC-088.webp","folderId":"ty-folder-4","imageScale":1,"imagePositionX":50,"imagePositionY":50,"revealLevels":[{"level":1,"text":"沈漫说自己在玄盾国际公开榜和私榜上都赫赫有名。"},{"level":2,"text":"她说李好的名字大概在私榜低位，有人出钱通缉。"}],"fallbackColor":"#b09a6e","fallbackIcon":"fa-ranking-star","audioPath":""},{"id":"ty-black-car","title":"无人黑车","imagePath":"","folderId":"ty-folder-4","imageScale":1,"imagePositionX":50,"imagePositionY":50,"revealLevels":[{"level":1,"text":"5月8日夜事务所外、5月9日夜欲子家对街出现无人驾驶黑色SUV，红外和X光确认无人。"},{"level":2,"text":"追车被红灯和交警截停，车向西消失，车牌全网检索失败。"}],"fallbackColor":"#b09a6e","fallbackIcon":"fa-car","audioPath":""},{"id":"ty-lost-ones","title":"迷失者","imagePath":"worlds/taiyi/assets/npc/avatars/LS-NPC-088.webp","folderId":"ty-folder-5","imageScale":1,"imagePositionX":50,"imagePositionY":50,"revealLevels":[{"level":1,"text":"沈漫说数据化进入赛博世界后失去自我认知的人是迷失者，对老王头只说是猜测。"},{"level":2,"text":"沈漫另说：消失者以数据重构再现，约3至4个月器官衰竭；有人掌握规则用于私欲。"}],"fallbackColor":"#6e9aa8","fallbackIcon":"fa-person-circle-question","audioPath":""},{"id":"ty-rabbit-hole","title":"兔子洞与红皇后","imagePath":"","folderId":"ty-folder-5","imageScale":1,"imagePositionX":50,"imagePositionY":50,"revealLevels":[{"level":1,"text":"老王头面馆的rh06.1x1程序，时间戳是1970年1月1日，运行后死灵术士钻出。"},{"level":2,"text":"沈漫说程序作者的称号是红皇后；天海电脑上另有rh007.exe。"}],"fallbackColor":"#6e9aa8","fallbackIcon":"fa-rabbit","audioPath":""},{"id":"ty-tianhai","title":"天海与追风","imagePath":"","folderId":"ty-folder-5","imageScale":1,"imagePositionX":50,"imagePositionY":50,"revealLevels":[{"level":1,"text":"沈漫说天海是套壳公司，注册资本1200万，员工仅5人，CEO被捕后全部消失。"},{"level":2,"text":"李好查到天海日常资金由追风出行打款；沈漫建议暂不硬查追风。"}],"fallbackColor":"#6e9aa8","fallbackIcon":"fa-sitemap","audioPath":""},{"id":"ty-sh-txt","title":"S.H.的TXT","imagePath":"worlds/taiyi/assets/npc/avatars/LS-NPC-072.webp","folderId":"ty-folder-5","imageScale":1,"imagePositionX":50,"imagePositionY":50,"revealLevels":[{"level":1,"text":"工云广场网吧里，电脑弹出TXT：你们来迟了，看看窗外。"},{"level":2,"text":"落款S.H.，让他们走吧，这里查不到东西了。桌上没有回应。"}],"fallbackColor":"#6e9aa8","fallbackIcon":"fa-terminal","audioPath":""},{"id":"ty-sh-heling","title":"何凌口中的S.H.","imagePath":"worlds/taiyi/assets/npc/avatars/LS-NPC-072.webp","folderId":"ty-folder-5","imageScale":1,"imagePositionX":50,"imagePositionY":50,"revealLevels":[{"level":1,"text":"何凌自述遭枪击后被代号S.H.的人救起并觉醒。"},{"level":2,"text":"李好不知道S.H.是谁，也没有证实与网吧TXT的落款是同一人。"}],"fallbackColor":"#6e9aa8","fallbackIcon":"fa-user-secret","audioPath":""},{"id":"ty-necromancer","title":"死灵术士的回归","imagePath":"","folderId":"ty-folder-5","imageScale":1,"imagePositionX":50,"imagePositionY":50,"revealLevels":[{"level":1,"text":"死灵术士被天灾逼退前，说对雷武龙有兴趣，很快会再来找他。"},{"level":2,"text":"他想让PC把数据因子进贡给他，说两人迟早会被他拿下。"}],"fallbackColor":"#6e9aa8","fallbackIcon":"fa-hat-wizard","audioPath":""},{"id":"ty-silver-thread","title":"银线与白发幻视","imagePath":"","folderId":"ty-folder-5","imageScale":1,"imagePositionX":50,"imagePositionY":50,"revealLevels":[{"level":1,"text":"欲子中枪濒死时经历银线与青铜祭祀幻视，看到被固定在铜柱上的年轻白发女性，面容看不清。"},{"level":2,"text":"医生解释子弹偏转、头皮枪伤与脑震荡。"}],"fallbackColor":"#6e9aa8","fallbackIcon":"fa-wave-square","audioPath":""}]
